# Speaker fill reference: today's VLC speakerfill filter and speakerfill_output module, recorded before the
# Rust port by indra/llaudio/tests/speakerfill_record.cpp (built from vlc_speakerfill_test.cpp's harness) with
# libvlc 3.0.21 Vetinari, the filter built by MSVC (vlc_speakerfill target), the output by llvm-mingw (vlc_speakerfill_output).
# VLC channel order: L R ML MR RL RR RC C LFE; the output module maps it to FL FR SL SR BL BR BC FC LFE and
# writes WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE order (FL FR FC LFE BL BR BC SL SR). Values are %.9g floats.

# fill <source> <target mask> <impulse on input channel> -> bypass|fill, output channels in VLC order
#   and the same frame in the device's WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE order (speakerfill-smooth-gain off)
fill stereo none in=L -> bypass vlc[L,R]=1 0 device[FL,FR]=1 0
fill stereo none in=R -> bypass vlc[L,R]=0 1 device[FL,FR]=0 1
fill stereo 2.0 in=L -> bypass vlc[L,R]=1 0 device[FL,FR]=1 0
fill stereo 2.0 in=R -> bypass vlc[L,R]=0 1 device[FL,FR]=0 1
fill stereo 4.0 in=L -> fill vlc[L,R,RL,RR]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 device[FL,FR,BL,BR]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0
fill stereo 4.0 in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,RL,RR]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 device[FL,FR,BL,BR]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769
fill stereo 2.1 in=L -> fill vlc[L,R,LFE]=0.707106769 0 0 device[FL,FR,LFE]=0.707106769 0 0
fill stereo 2.1 in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,LFE]=0 0.707106769 0 device[FL,FR,LFE]=0 0.707106769 0
fill stereo 4.1rear in=L -> fill vlc[L,R,RL,RR,LFE]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 0 device[FL,FR,LFE,BL,BR]=0.707106769 0 0 0.707106769 0
fill stereo 4.1rear in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,RL,RR,LFE]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 device[FL,FR,LFE,BL,BR]=0 0.707106769 0 0 0.707106769
fill stereo 4.1side in=L -> fill vlc[L,R,ML,MR,LFE]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 0 device[FL,FR,LFE,SL,SR]=0.707106769 0 0 0.707106769 0
fill stereo 4.1side in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,ML,MR,LFE]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 device[FL,FR,LFE,SL,SR]=0 0.707106769 0 0 0.707106769
fill stereo 4.0side in=L -> fill vlc[L,R,ML,MR]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 device[FL,FR,SL,SR]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0
fill stereo 4.0side in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,ML,MR]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 device[FL,FR,SL,SR]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769
fill stereo 5.1rear in=L -> fill vlc[L,R,RL,RR,C,LFE]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 0.353553385 0 device[FL,FR,FC,LFE,BL,BR]=0.707106769 0 0.353553385 0 0.707106769 0
fill stereo 5.1rear in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,RL,RR,C,LFE]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0.353553385 0 device[FL,FR,FC,LFE,BL,BR]=0 0.707106769 0.353553385 0 0 0.707106769
fill stereo 5.1side in=L -> fill vlc[L,R,ML,MR,C,LFE]=0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 0.353553385 0 device[FL,FR,FC,LFE,SL,SR]=0.707106769 0 0.353553385 0 0.707106769 0
fill stereo 5.1side in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,ML,MR,C,LFE]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0.353553385 0 device[FL,FR,FC,LFE,SL,SR]=0 0.707106769 0.353553385 0 0 0.707106769

fill stereo 7.1 in=R -> fill vlc[L,R,ML,MR,RL,RR,C,LFE]=0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769 0.353553385 0 device[FL,FR,FC,LFE,BL,BR,SL,SR]=0 0.707106769 0.353553385 0 0 0.707106769 0 0.707106769

# gain curve: setMusicGain(volume) publishes speakerfill-gain (llvlcspeakerfillconfig.cpp)
curve volume=0 -> gain=0
curve volume=0.0500000007 -> gain=0.000125000006
curve volume=0.100000001 -> gain=0.00100000005
curve volume=0.104999997 -> gain=0.00115762488
curve volume=0.125 -> gain=0.001953125
curve volume=0.25 -> gain=0.015625
curve volume=0.5 -> gain=0.125
curve volume=0.75 -> gain=0.421875
curve volume=0.899999976 -> gain=0.728999913
curve volume=1 -> gain=1
curve muted: setMusicGain(0.5, muted) -> gain=0.125 music-hard-mute=1 (the filter writes 0 while hard-muted)
